title: Fullmag project manifest (.fms → manifest.json)
description: The start-screen-relevant surface of the project manifest inside a .fms archive. This document specifies ONLY the metadata the launcher needs — identity, provenance, authorship, history and run records. Model, mesh, materials and study definitions keep their existing schemas and are referenced here by file, not redefined. Field names follow the snake_case convention of the existing OpenAPI contract (ProjectDocumentResource).

schema_version.description: Manifest schema. The app migrates 1.0 and 1.1 on open, writing a migrated copy and leaving the source file untouched. A manifest newer than the running build is refused with a clear message rather than guessed at.

revision.description: Monotonic, incremented on every persisted change. Mirrors ProjectDocumentResource.revision.

source_hash.description: Hash of the archive bytes at the last save; used to detect out-of-band edits.

authors.description: Ordered. The first creator is the one shown when the inspector has room for a single name.

preferred_bibtex.description: Overrides the BibTeX the inspector generates from authors + name + revision. Set when the project is tied to a published dataset.

preferred_device.description: Pins execution to a backend. When the machine cannot provide it, the start screen warns before the run rather than falling back silently.

model_ref.description: Paths inside the archive. The launcher does not parse these; it only reports that they exist and how large they are.

summary.description: Human-readable denormalisation of the model, written on save so the inspector can render the Overview tab without loading the model. Same shape as recent-index model_summary.

colouring.description: How the magnetisation was mapped to colour, so a thumbnail is never read with the wrong convention.

history.description: Append-only. The inspector shows the most recent entries and offers a per-entry restore; the full list stays in the archive.

runs.description: One record per execution. Run outputs live in their own directories; this is the index over them.

migration.description: Present when the manifest was written by an older build and needs upgrading. Mirrors ProjectMigrationResource.

lossless.description: False when the migration drops information. The start screen then says so before writing the migrated copy.

by.description: Author name as recorded in authors[].

kind.description: Drives the timeline marker colour: edit = accent, run = success, migrate = degraded, import = info.

changes.description: Specific, verifiable lines — "cell z 10 → 5 nm", not "updated the mesh".

revision.description: Project revision this run was executed from.

error.description: One sentence, user-facing, cause first. Surfaced verbatim in the inspector banner, so it is written for a physicist, not for a log.
